hypothesis: The 512-step v2 pilot may be undertrained. Increase only the training interaction/update budget to 4096, preserving environment, observations, losses, learning rates, seeds and final-checkpoint selection. Test economic performance against cash and exact observation-vector controls; compare all-seed changes with frozen v2 descriptively. More training is not assumed to help.
primaryUseCase: single-instrument target exposure; shared policy across BTC/ETH/SOL, independent capital accounts, no portfolio allocation claim

data.availability: ASSUMED closeTime+1ms; no historical first-seen witness; promotion blocked
data.license: Binance provider terms; do not redistribute raw data
data.contamination: All rows are already exposed development data: earlier 45 adaptive trials and the September sequential screen. New methods are adaptive successors, not independent confirmation.
data.holdout: No final holdout read or allocation. Existing 1227 returns and carry outcomes through 2027-01-20 remain protected. No raw full snapshots or collectors.

partition: Stops exclusive; rewards mature strictly before trainStop. Six inherited separation bars are conservative, not a claim of an additional embargo; forward-only training has no post-test embargo region. Evaluation contains 64 transitions per symbol/fold, one cash start and one terminal close, never reset to hide a failure.

environment.observation: causal-close-inventory-v3 plus support flag, remaining finite-horizon fraction, pending target; explicit new 12-input version, incompatible with legacy policies
environment.normalization: Each episode fits only its strictly pre-decision burn-in with causal_replay_v3; immutable thereafter. No outcome-based calibration or predictor fits.
environment.actionSemantics: Raw categorical proposal remains the learning action. Decision support projection remains v1. At next-close simulated fill, compute the immutable exact-kernel preview. Only turnover_limit triggers a fresh zero-target execution from the ORIGINAL state; the rejected preview is never committed or charged. With partial fills, zero is a target, not a claim of immediate flatness. Other economic termination and resource failures remain unchanged.
environment.ledger: replay-accounting-v2 exact bounded rational unit ledger, initial equity 1, futures PnL and event funding, 5bp fee+0.5bp half-spread+4.5bp slippage, terminal costs exactly once
environment.reward: 100*(equity_after-equity_before)/initial_equity; no shaping or clipping; external cash flow zero
environment.discountRationale: finite 32-transition training objective; gamma=1 preserves the telescoping economic reward. Remaining time is observed. Longer 64-step evaluation is a disclosed horizon shift.
environment.execution: Proposal at completed close; old units earn PnL/funding before fill at following close. Price-taking exogenous history, no market impact calibration. Delay stress holds one pending permitted target; next proposal may be ignored while a reservation is pending, explicitly logged.
environment.risk: Same v1 limits. A pre-fill admissible position has exposure <=0.35, so a zero target with fill in (0,1] requires turnover <=0.35 <0.50. Cost-induced economic risk still terminates and blocks adoption. This is isolated simulated recovery, not an operational live fallback.
environment.unsupported: zero target in isolated simulator, with costs; not a claim that flattening is an operationally safe live fallback
environment.limits: No authentic precision/min-notional/liquidity/queue calibration; no live inference or shared production reservations; blocks integration. Rational arithmetic exhaustion fails the trial, never silently rounds or resets.
environment.intervention: Log support unavailable separately; actionChanged means decision support changed the proposal or final turnover admission changed a due target. Scheduling/deferred/ignored proposals are reported separately, not called risk interventions. Final horizon liquidation is separately logged.

algorithms.ppo: 12x16 tanh categorical actor/separate value net; immutable optimizer_snapshot_v2; raw GAE v2 lambda=.95; checked PPO clipped surrogate .2; lr .0003; 4 epochs/128 fresh simulator transitions
algorithms.double_dqn: 12x16 tanh, online argmax/target evaluation, epsilon=.2 fresh simulation blocks with replay, batch64, lr .001, target snapshot sync every100 updates, corrected value_objective_v2 alpha0
algorithms.cql: same value network and target mechanism, corrected discrete scalar CQL(H)-inspired logsumexp penalty alpha .1; frozen 512-transition uniform simulator dataset per fold before fitting; regenerate with identical factory/seed and require both original v2 buffer hashes before any fit; no new collection during updates
algorithms.behavior_cloning: same actor, supervised likelihood on same frozen simulated uniform proposals; not counted as RL
algorithms.deviations: 4096 PPO/DDQN simulator transitions; PPO 128 actor updates (4 per rollout), DDQN 4096 updates. CQL/alpha0/BC 4096 updates on unchanged 512-transition data: an optimization-budget test, not a larger offline-data test. Still small CPU prototypes, not official benchmark reproductions or converged finalists.

champion: Preserved. Exact live adopted-combo snapshot/causal replay not available in main; do not substitute a proxy and claim comparison. PR330 is separate evidence, not an imported baseline.
selection: Exactly 50 fits (30 primary RL, 10 CQL alpha0, 10 BC), 1218 seven-stress replays, last checkpoint only. No best-seed/checkpoint/search selection or outcome-driven retries. Same seeds are paired algorithmic replications, not independent histories. Frozen v2 remains the 512-budget reference; no retraining it. One adaptive budget setting adds 50 recorded fits to prior search effort.
primaryStatistic: Paired total net equity change against cash and normalized_momentum3 over identical complete 64-transition windows, equal weight symbols/folds, all seeds. Baselines included before outcome inspection. Failed paths block comparisons and adoption. Improvement must exceed 0.001 with a positive simultaneous lower bound; all existing risk gates also required. Current champion and confirmation remain missing regardless.

riskGates.interventionDefinition: actionChanged; old unsupported/deferred reason flag preserved separately, not directly comparable

statistics: As v2: circular blocks 3/9/21, 2000 draws, seed20261010, six primary comparisons with Bonferroni intervals. Dependence assumptions are weak with only two exposed windows. No confirmatory p-values. Parent-budget changes are descriptive only, no extra hypothesis-testing claims. DSR/PBO insufficient. This correction is within campaign only and does not control all cumulative adaptive research selection.
ope: No real behavior logs or defensible real propensities. Frozen dataset is simulated uniform proposal behavior, with exact 1/3 probabilities and many-to-one shield mapping. Report support/action counts and critic calibration on frozen held-out simulator paths; no invented real IS/DR/FQE estimate or live support claim.
ablations: CQL alpha0 on the same frozen buffer, all seeds; diagnostic ordinary offline DDQN, not an additional appropriate offline RL learner. No predictor, recurrence or reward shaping inputs exist to ablate.
proofGates: new audit validates final target and actionChanged

budget.failureHandling: Retain partial registry and report incomplete on interruption; no silent continuation or chosen-seed replacement.

limits: No masking or decoder change: action aliasing under unsupported observations remains a known issue and the 20% intervention gate is unchanged. No production integration, authentic availability, current-champion replay, real OPE or untouched confirmation. Delayed pending commitments remain a test-time shift. This tests one budget sensitivity and cannot establish learning convergence or profitability.
baselineContract: Cash and constant-long use no extra information. Normalized momentum/reversal take only sign of observation[1], the normalized three-bar return. They measure deviation from burn-in mean, not raw trend. Reuse the vector-only supplemental v2 implementation. No raw-history comparator is a primary baseline.
